'''Steelious''' was a [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that was located near the world [[Yarrv]]. The [[Hervack Spaceport]] on Steelious served as an important [[Spaceport/Legends|port]] for [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]]. Shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomats]] from Steelious traveled to Yarrv in order to negotiate a [[Merchant/Legends|trade]] agreement with the latter planet's ruling [[Noble/Legends|royal]] family. Yarrv's [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Karin]], in the hopes of subjugating Steelious, planned to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] the diplomats, causing a war between the two planets that would benefit the military conglomerate owned by the baron.

==Description==
Steelious was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Royal" /> located in the [[Steelious system/Legends|Steelious system]], a part of the [[Southern Core]] portion of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was situated near the planet [[Yarrv]].<ref name="Royal" />

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Karin]]<ref name="Royal" /> of Yarrv's [[Darpheos]] [[City-state/Legends|city-state]] hoped to become that planet's [[King/Legends|king]] and subjugate Steelious through war.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|199|Karin, Baron}}</ref> Another reason why Karin wished to initiate armed conflict between Yarrv and Steelious was because he controlled a large military conglomerate that would gain profit as a result of the war.<ref name="Royal" />

A group of [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomats]] from Steelious traveled to Yarrv on a diplomatic [[Starship/Legends|starship]]<ref name="Royal" /> shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]<ref name="CSWE" /> in order to open [[Merchant/Legends|trade]] negotiations with the ruling [[Noble/Legends|royal]] family of Yarrv. The proposed trade agreement would limit Karin's power, and to prevent it from being signed, the baron plotted to have both the diplomats and the reigning king of Yarrv [[Assassin/Legends|assassinated]]. Karin further planned to redirect the blame for the assassination toward a radical group on Steelious, which would likely cause a war to erupt between the two planets.<ref name="Royal" />

==Locations==
Customs were notoriously lax on Steelious during the Galactic Civil War. As a result, [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] goods to and from the planet was easy, and the [[Hervack Spaceport]] on Steelious served as an important [[Spaceport/Legends|port]] in the planet's [[Sector/Legends|sector]] for goods illegally [[Transport/Legends|transported]] by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="Royal" />

==Behind the scenes==
Steelious was created by [[Bill Olmesdahl]] for "[[The Royal Family]]," a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure hook published in the [[1992]] supplement ''[[Star Wars Gamemaster Screen]]'' for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Royal" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Steelious [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore Steelious itself, in grid square K-13.<ref name="TEA" />
